d:
Luka Dončić’s ridiculous heater continues! Watch highlights from his last five games, capped by a 42-point, 13-assist, 7-rebound, 6-three-pointer, 2-steal night.
Luka has now scored 35+ points in five straight games, including back-to-back 40-point performances. Over the stretch he’s averaging 43.4 points, 8.6 assists, 8.4 rebounds and 6.8 threes per game.
That makes him one of only two players in NBA history with 35+ points, 5+ rebounds, 5+ assists and 5+ threes in five straight games, joining Damian Lillard, who did it from Jan. 20 to Jan. 31, 2020.
